scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.
author: /root

contracts.definition: Phase1 preserves existing syscall number and args0..4 exactly; explicitly writes args5=0. Phase2 rewrites only original args0..2, preserving initialized phase1 args3,4 and defined-zero arg5. Preserve helper-owned ID/valid writes and original publication/response order. No blanket request initialization or invented transport seed. No mutation while prior request borrowed.
contracts.limits: No response/ACK synthesis, descriptor/flattened-argument/filename lifetime decision or endpoint/service clearance. Actual selected consumer semantic arity and raw field initialization must be independently checked.

contracts.definition: Preserve original process pid, thread tid, sig conversions in x86 argument fields0..2; explicitly set argument fields3..5=0 before existing __NR_kill generic forwarding. Use raw MaybeUninit context and initialize only the six argument fields; no whole-context initialized reference or aggregate zero.
contracts.limits: Keep original target/thread lifetime, lock, send/reply, logger and errno ordering; no transport-owned field or UTI initialization.

contracts.definition: For syscall_forward_rt_sigprocmask_bridge preserve exactly original arg0=sigmask; define transmitted args1..5=0. For syscall_forward_sigaction_update_bridge preserve arg0=sig, arg1=act->sa.sa_handler, arg2=act->sa.sa_flags; define args3..5=0. Write six argument fields through raw uninitialized context storage, without whole-context reference/zero.
contracts.limits: These are existing custom selected executor payload shapes, not replacements of the Linux APIs. Require exact selected semantic consumers to use the original initialized payload fields; any consumer assigning semantic meaning to additional slots must be explicitly dispositioned before selection. Keep current validation, action/mask semantics, ordering and all genuine restrictions.

contracts.definition: Event4 retains same prefix,newline,logical C source tuple24429 and value as signed32 %d. Render result as unsigned32 lower hexadecimal with minimum width8 and zero padding, passing actual u32/CUInt to %08x. Thus -1 is explicitly ffffffff. Other events produce no output.
contracts.limits: Intentional defined diagnostic correction; no claim of parity for an invalid signed variadic argument. No ptrace action, signal, errno, synchronization or lifetime change.

contracts.definition: Two original long-valued exec diagnostics use %ld with the same CLong signed values, events and source metadata; no truncation or semantic action change.
contracts.limits: Defined diagnostic correction, not undefined C variadic parity.

unchanged: ca85 named2/3/wait wire contract and f847 natural request alignment remain. No service/account/rejected-operation hold is cleared, no general packet/response/UTI zero or unsupported exclusion. No runtime/build/native grant.
